what: Completed 3-phase optimization initiative for sv-memory: DB tuning, sync compaction, and query optimization
why: Systematic code review identified 10+ issues ranging from missing indexes and connection pool misconfiguration to N+1 query patterns and non-atomic file writes. All three phases were validated via existing test suite without regressions.
learned: modernc.org/sqlite benefits greatly from explicit PRAGMAs (mmap_size, cache_size, busy_timeout) and connection pool tuning (split writer/reader). Incremental graph rebuild via mtime/size comparison avoids O(n) rescans. In-memory BFS with 2 bulk queries eliminates N+1 pattern entirely.
author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)
impact: All 10+ identified performance issues addressed across internal/db, internal/mcp, internal/memory, and internal/graph packages. All existing tests pass, go vet is clean.
next_steps: Monitor real-world perf with SV_MEMORY_DEBUG=1 in an MCP client session. Consider adding a dedicated in-memory benchmark test for BFS traversal speed.
